name: kylas-crm-mcp-server
description: MCP server to interact with Kylas CRM: create/manage leads, deals, contacts, tasks, companies, and meetings.
long_description: Connect Claude to your Kylas CRM account to create and manage leads, deals, contacts, tasks, companies, and meetings — all from natural language.

server_url.title: Kylas MCP Server URL
server_url.description: URL of your Kylas MCP server.

api_key.title: Kylas API Key (optional)
api_key.description: Paste your Kylas API key to connect without a browser sign-in. Leave blank to use OAuth (sign in via your browser on first connect).
